title: Python fundamentals for analysis
review_type: Specialist author instructional, arithmetic, source and executable-behavior review; root independently reviews and alone accepts in dependency order

reviewed.reasoning: Reviewed exact integer money units versus approximate discounting, annual effective basis-point conversion, t=0 versus later year ends, pure functions and mutation/aliasing, explicit type/value/schema/unit validation, error propagation and failure-versus-zero distinction. Separated economic assumptions and materiality from floating representation error and numeric test tolerances. Documented finite supported rate/horizon/magnitude bounds and the distinct mathematical r=-1 singularity. External validation never relies on assert; assertions are taught only as test/internal checks, with explicit -O removal discussion.
reviewed.arithmetic: Recomputed order sales, variable cost, contribution and fixed-cost profit from separate order-margin grouping; verified the new-order/fixed-cost exercise. Independently derived NPV using exact fractions and backwards Horner recurrence, distinct from the program's forward discounted powers. Baseline is 430000/121 cents; exercise case is 74840000/9261 cents. Checked zero-rate and time-zero boundaries, one-period and negative-rate cases, exact cancellation and the one-period indexing error factor. A 49-case exact-reference grid includes both supported rate endpoints, 100-year horizon and maximum input magnitudes with scale-aware comparison tolerances.
reviewed.solutions: All eight exercise prompts have complete solutions. Executed all thirteen displayed Python instructional/solution blocks in presented order with the explicitly supplied downloaded validator; verified the intentionally broken function's printed value, None return and input mutation, then the pure correction. Checked value/type expressions, integer-cent signed outputs and invalid values, order sensitivity, NPV displays and exact references, safe file-reading pattern, and test design criteria. Open critique/test-design solutions specify acceptable mechanisms rather than a single preferred wording.
reviewed.instruction: Introduces script/terminal distinction, assignment/comments/calls, types/operators/collections, indentation/conditions/loops, function return/contracts, exceptions, approximate arithmetic, imports, file/JSON handling, then the complete offline NPV program and assertions. Explains helper syntax used in the download, including exact-type checks, chained comparisons, short-circuit or, strip, keyword configuration, path resolution, decoder callback, entry-point guard and exit status. Defines necessary numerical units and timing before using them. Downloadable program, JSON and text README require no third-party installation; README provides one-command execution and modification experiments.
reviewed.sources: Inspected eleven narrowly scoped official Python 3.14 documentation routes for primitive syntax/collections, control/functions, exceptions, floating arithmetic, math, decimal further study, files/encoding, pathlib, JSON and assert. Proposed catalogue entries retain URL, use, check date and inspection scope. Versioned documentation supports method semantics, not a claim about a historical Python point release; Python 3.14.6 is the locally observed execution environment. Original prose, monetary problems, synthetic file and code are author-created.
reviewed.structure: Fragment contains no document wrapper or h1, two worked-example asides, eight exercise items and eight solution items, capability/prerequisite statement, assumptions and boundaries, sources, teach-back, delayed check and successor link. Local checker matches all data-source IDs to proposed catalogue and checks real download targets. Download hrefs are flat because build.py copies content/projects files to the distribution root. Root retains responsibility for whole-library build, source integration, links and dependency-order acceptance.
